title: ZPA Private Service Edge Release Summary (2026)

blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) Private Service Edge version.
An update was released for Private Service Edge for Private Access (ZPA) that includes bug fixes, optimizations, and version enhancements.
Your Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see Understanding Software Updates in Private Access.
To learn more, see Manager Software Updates.
This release of Private Service Edge for Private Access (ZPA) includes the following updates:

blocks.item: Bug fixes, optimizations, and version enhancements.

Access policies support nested criteria, including NOT operators in policy criteria and across nested criteria. To learn more, see Support for Nested Criteria, NOT Operators, and Bulk Actions in Global Rules and Policy Groups.

This release of Private Service Edge for Private Access (ZPA) includes the following updates:

blocks.item: Support for bug fixes, optimizations, and version enhancements.
Applications configured at the Microtenant level can be shared with users in the default tenant. To learn more, see Share Applications with the Default Microtenant.

Access policies support nested criteria, including AND operators and OR operators. You can also move or delete rules in bulk within a policy group. To learn more, see Support for Nested Criteria, NOT Operators, and Bulk Actions in Global Rules and Policy Groups.

blocks.text: Your Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see Understanding Software Updates in Private Access.

An update was released to prevent triggering certificate renewal for Private Service Edges when a certificate was valid for less than 180 days and wasn't enabled for Business Continuity, and a related certificate sync issue occurred. If needed, you can restart the Private Service Edge by entering the following command in the Private Service Edge console:
systemctl restart zpa-service-edge
